rows.ja: 供給元(配信・クラウド)

companies.name: Akamai Technologies
companies.sub: コンテンツ配信・セキュリティ

relations.text: Akamaiが年次報告で、顧客の1社としてAirbnbを挙げている(Airbnbにとっては供給元)
relations.text_en: Akamai’s 10-K lists Airbnb among its customers (Akamai is a supplier to Airbnb)

source.label: Akamai Technologies 10-K
source.quote: Our customers include many of the world's leading corporations, such as adidas, Adobe, Aflac, Airbnb, Asus, Autodesk, Bank of Montreal, Carnival Corporation, Comcast, Commerzbank, Daiwa Institute of Research, eBay, Electronic Arts, Epic Games, Fidelity Investments,
source.note: Akamaiの年次報告に基づく記載です。

relations.text: AWSをAirbnbが優先するクラウド事業者とし、OpenAIのモデルをAmazon Bedrock経由でも利用できる
relations.text_en: AWS is Airbnb’s preferred cloud provider, and OpenAI models are accessible through Amazon Bedrock on AWS

source.label: Airbnb — OpenAI model-access agreement, September 23, 2026
source.quote: The agreement gives us broader access to OpenAI models through OpenAI's APIs and Amazon Bedrock on AWS, Airbnb's preferred cloud provider.
source.note: 2026年9月23日のAirbnb発表に基づきます。

relations.text: 新たな契約により、Airbnbのエンジニアリング・製品開発チームがOpenAIの先端モデルをより広く利用できる
relations.text_en: Under a new agreement, Airbnb engineering and product development teams get broader access to OpenAI frontier models

source.label: Airbnb — OpenAI model-access agreement, September 23, 2026
source.quote: Under a new agreement, our engineering and product development teams get broader access to OpenAI frontier models.

relations.text: 新たな契約により、GPT-6 Astraを含むOpenAIの先端モデルへのアクセスを拡大する
relations.text_en: Under a new agreement, Airbnb teams get broader access to OpenAI frontier models, including GPT-6 Astra

source.label: Airbnb — OpenAI model-access agreement, September 23, 2026
source.quote: Under a new agreement, we're giving Airbnb engineering and product development teams broader access to OpenAI frontier models, including GPT-6 Astra.

companies.name: モルガン・スタンレー

relations.text: モルガン・スタンレー系列が主導する貸し手団が、10億ドルの無担保リボルビング・クレジット契約(5年)の初期コミットメントを提供した
relations.text_en: A group of lenders led by Morgan Stanley Senior Funding, Inc. provided initial commitments of $1.0 billion under a five-year unsecured revolving credit agreement

source.label: Airbnb 10-K
source.quote: In October 2022, the Company terminated its then existing credit facility and entered into a five-year unsecured Revolving Credit Agreement, which provides for initial commitments by a group of lenders led by Morgan Stanley Senior Funding, Inc. of $ 1.0 billion (“2022 Credit Facility”).
source.note: 融資のみの関係で、2022年10月の契約です。

relations.text: 2022年10月31日付のリボルビング・クレジット契約の当事者として、Morgan Stanley Seniorが記載されている(2023年2月16日改定)
relations.text_en: Morgan Stanley Senior is a party to the Revolving Credit Agreement dated October 31, 2022, as amended February 16, 2023

source.label: Airbnb 10-K
source.quote: Revolving Credit Agreement, dated October 31, 2022, by and among the Registrant, certain subsidiaries of the Registrant, and Morgan Stanley Senior, as amended on February 16, 2023

relations.text: Airbnbの年次報告が、競合として挙げている
relations.text_en: Named as a competitor in Airbnb’s annual report

source.label: Airbnb 10-K
source.quote: We also face competition from search engines like Google, which can influence search traffic and promote their own travel services, potentially disintermediating our platform.

note.ja: 公式資料で確認できた関係だけを載せています。投資判断を勧めるものではありません。
note.en: Only relationships confirmed in official materials are shown. Not investment advice.
